name: phone-controller
description: Use an iPhone as a touch controller for a Windows PC: stream the PC screen to the phone and send key/mouse input back.

scripts.dev: npm run build:client && npm run dev -w host
scripts.start: npm run build:client && npm run start -w host
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w client && npm run typecheck -w host
scripts.build: npm run build:client && npm run build -w host
scripts.dist: npm run build:client && npm run dist -w host
